messages:
tina: FYI we're going to trial a new sampling-proxy shim that emits 'shadow_meter' events to improve quota inference for short lived sessions. This will route a tiny fraction of traffic through the shim at 0.2% to start. tagging billing + eng-platform
hamid: Are these billable? invoice-preview must not pick up these shadow events as real usage
lee: agree. we need a clear schema and a filtration guarantee in invoice-staging. Also need tests for streaming partials (we had issues where partial streaming tokens became phantom charges)
tina: Not billable. We're adding two fields: sample_kind="shadow_meter_v1" and billable=false. We'll keep tenant_id + route_id the same so quota math benefits. Example payload:
```json
{"event_type":"shadow_meter","tenant_id":"t-foo","route_id":"r-chat","sample_id":"s-2026-03-21-1","sample_kind":"shadow_meter_v1","billable":false}
```
maria: sending to the metering topic makes sense for attribution, but invoice-staging must drop billable=false before aggregation. add a prefilter hook as early as possible
hamid: Also confirm dedupe behaviour. If the sampling-proxy retries, we need dedupe_id semantics so invoice runs never see duplicates
tina: We'll include dedupe_key=sample:{sample_id} and set dedupe window = 30m. ledger/aggregator will treat billable=false rows as non-cost but they will still increment quota visibility counters
lee: Important: console preview and per-tenant dashboards should default to hiding these samples. Add small banner "Shadow samples suppressed in billing preview". Power users can toggle show-shadow=true to inspect
maria: add metric sampling.proxy.sample_rate and an alert >0.5% accidental ramp. Also add a gauge for sample.dedupe_collisions > 0
hamid: canary plan: 0.2% tenants (30 tenants) for 2 hours -> 1% -> 5% -> roll. emit metric shadow_meter.canary=true during test
tina: deploy-bot: sampling-proxy v1 deployed to canary cluster 2026-03-21T13:15Z
billing-bot: NOTICE: metering topic observed +1.9% message volume on canary edges; monitoring invoice-staging output for any billable rows
lee: add unit tests in ledger-builder: assert billable=false rows never contribute to invoice totals and are filtered pre-aggregation. integration test: simulate retry replay and ensure dedupe prevents double counts
maria: backfill plan: script tools/shadow-reconcile --from=2026-03-21T10:00Z --to=2026-03-21T14:00Z that flags any invoice rows referencing sample_id:* and creates a review ticket. no automatic invoice adjustments without manual approval
tina: adding telemetry tag shadow_migration=2026-03-21 and trace_id sample-rollout-8160009999 on all related metrics for searchability
hamid: UI change: preview hide by default, but show a compact row in the audit log for ops that lists suppressed sample counts per route
lee: dashboard: add card showing shadow_meter.count by route + dedupe collisions, widget pinned to metering ops board
deploy-bot: canary healthcheck: sampling-proxy canary at +1.6% topic vol, dedupe collisions = 0 2026-03-21T13:22Z
billing-bot: invoice-staging sanity-check: no billable=false rows were included in the preview job for the last run
maria: please open ENG ticket with rollout notes + console request for preview suppression and the reconcile script. billing ops wants a 1-paragraph summary for on-call
tina: opened ENG-6022, added runbook steps, dashboard links, sample schema, and the reconcile tool. Will report after 1% ramp. thanks all :thumbsup:
